applied.description: audited for scaffold leaks: no YAML frontmatter, no '## User Prompt (VERBATIM)' / scaffold / prompt-decomposition / coverage-checklist sections, no 'Here is the report' preamble, no backticked headings, no [[interim-*]] wikilinks, no [I<n>] workspace refs, no pipeline vocabulary (Locus N / Tension N / comparisons.md / cross-locus / width corpus / depth investigation / per the scaffold). Zero leaks found; zero hygiene edits required. All [N] markers and the Sources list left untouched.

E02 resolved: the exec-summary paragraph 2, SS7G and SS9B all argued 'every published estimate is unidentified' in near-identical words. Kept the exec-summary instance intact (reader sees it first, carries the specific numbers); kept SS7G because it holds the unique matched-null-operator control evidence, compressed via cross-reference to SS7A; rewrote SS9B to state the verdict in one sentence and spend its space on which of the three identification failures is cheapest to remedy (the graded-dose one), per the patcher's recommendation.

SS1A Grade III no longer re-lists the three label-free penalties and the rejection-sampling / reward-reweighting constructions in full; SS3B states all three at length and SS1A now names them by citation only. Same treatment for Grade I (Afriat's theorem was restated verbatim from SS2A) and Grade II (the MILP repair programs are given in full in SS2C).

cross-section duplicate strikes: 15.22%->4.40%, 'exactly 0%' and 17-31% removed from the lede (all three restated in full in SS3B/SS5A); 8,000-run and 0.8-4.1%/33-67% figures removed from the SS5 preamble (restated in SS7E and SS5C); the verbalised-cost-ratio finding removed from SS3B (stated in SS3A); the reward-benchmark 'no consistency construct' clause removed from SS8C (stated in SS5 preamble); the endogenous-relation caveat removed from SS8B (stated in SS2B); 77.09->77.96 removed from SS7A (SS7D does the dissociation properly); the cardinal-dose magnitudes removed from SS9C cell two (now carried by the rewritten SS9B); the Afriat/Condorcet equivalence in SS8B shortened since SS4B states it first.

patcher-named high-yield targets, all four cut: the lede's first paragraph (enumerated results that SS3 and SS5 then state again in full); SS7E's poker paragraph (compressed roughly by half, all coefficients and the 21% power figure preserved); SS5B's multi-objective paragraph (the twelve raw cell scores collapsed to their reported direction, both citations preserved); SS2D's modern-extensions sentence.

removed restatement sentences that summarised the two or three sentences preceding them, at the ends of SS2B ('Hardness is asymptotic...'), SS2C/SS2D, SS3C ('The load-bearing consequence...'), SS4D, SS6A, SS7E ('Consistency and quality have been measured...'), SS8C and SS9D. Tightened the functional/operator definition in SS1A, the money-pump and coherence-theorem disclaimers in SS4A, and the third concession in SS7C.

split five over-long paragraphs at natural hinges without changing wording: SS2B (complexity stratification, ~370 words), SS4B (three refinements), SS4C (the Nash pole), SS7C (strict form vs general form of the rule), SS7F (reliability objection).

scanned for softeners ('suggests that', 'appears to', 'seems to', 'tends to', bare 'may/might/could' on evidenced claims) and for filler openers ('It is worth noting', 'Importantly', 'Notably', 'Of course', 'In essence'). None found in reader-facing prose; the surviving 'may' instances are on genuinely open mathematical or contested claims (non-attainment of the infimum, the contested weak-preference-signal reading) and were left as honesty rather than hedge.

escalations.issue: PRIMARY MANDATE NOT MET. Draft entered at ~16,249 words against a 10,000-word ceiling and leaves this pass at roughly 15,350 (net -900 words, -5,800 chars). Surgical hunks cannot deliver the remaining ~3,400 words. The binding constraint is the instruction 'do not cut any number with a citation attached': essentially every paragraph in SS2-SS9 is a chain of cited figures, so once the cross-section duplicates, the four patcher-named targets, the restatement sentences and the scaffold prose are gone, the remaining text is load-bearing evidence. Reaching 12,000 requires deleting whole subsections, which is regeneration, not polish. Ranked menu for the orchestrator, cheapest-first by evidence lost: (1) SS7F 'Can the instrument bear the inference?' ~850 words, costs the CCEI reliability critique [11][34] and SS7F's compression/headroom argument, which SS9D references; (2) SS9D 'Forward-looking assessment' ~700 words, not requested by the query, costs [61] and the exploitability framing; (3) SS8A+SS8B citation-graph analysis ~950 words, costs the two-fronts synthesis the query's final sentence implicitly asks for; (4) SS2D 'Minimal perturbation beyond GARP' ~300 words, costs [25][26][27][28][29] but [25] and [26] are directly responsive to 'minimal-perturbation restoration of rationalizability'. Cutting (1)+(2)+(4) lands ~13,500; adding (3) lands ~12,550. My recommendation: (1)+(2), which are the two least responsive to the verbatim query, and accept ~13,700.

No mismatch found; recording the check. The query's four asks are all delivered: interventions that correct/project/repair/enforce (SS1-SS6, with the four verbs explicitly mapped onto the three intervention grades in SS1A and tracked in the SS6 census columns); the coherence-to-downstream-quality relationship tested in both directions (SS7, both directions populated); the economics front including Afriat/Varian/Houtman-Maks and repair methods (SS2-SS3, including the Houtman-Maks two-goods threshold and the quantity-perturbation sketch); and the ML/alignment front including coherence theorems, Bradley-Terry/RLHF violations and Nash learning from human feedback (SS4-SS5). The 'two related but distinct search fronts' instruction is honoured structurally (SS2-SS3 vs SS4-SS5) and SS8 explicitly reconciles them. Citation style is inline [N] with one ## Sources section throughout; no wikilinks introduced. No format flip or fabricated recommendation was needed.

Partial residual on E02. The dedup is applied and SS9B has been repurposed as the patcher suggested, but SS7C (the target-alignment rule), SS7G (why nothing is identified) and SS9B now sit in a chain where SS7C does the analytic work and the other two point back at it. If the orchestrator takes the SS7F/SS9D cuts above, SS7G could be folded into SS7C's final paragraph for a further ~120 words; I did not attempt that merge because merging two subsections is regeneration rather than a hunk.
